title: Guideline spread sequence
slide_intent: Show related rules together because a designer needs to see how individual ingredients form a system.
strategic_value: The four photographed spreads can connect Mailchimp’s typographic voice, logo reproduction and color rationale.
demonstration: A four-frame loop presents photographed guideline spreads for Cooper Light, logo sizing, type spacing and Cavendish Yellow.
practical_value: Compare the roles of rationale, specimens and explicit rules across the selected spreads.
